„Budu víc přítomný“ neříká, kdy ani co u: “I will be more present” does not say when or what you will do. A seven-day step names a specific situation, action, time, and condition that will increase the chance that the attempt will actually happen.

Místo velkého odhalení můžeš zkusit malý: Instead of a big revelation, you can try a small safe test: state one personal preference and observe not only the other person's reaction but also what is happening within you.

Když je pocit vlastní hodnoty silně navá: When one's sense of self-worth is strongly tied to performance, success brings relief and failure affects one more than the result itself. A person then may not only strive for good work, but also for confirmation that they are enough.
Hodnota je použitelnější, když ji dokáže: A value is more useful when you can connect it with observable behavior. Respect can mean letting the other person finish a sentence, responsibility admitting a delay on time, and care protecting time for recovery.
Jeden čin poskytuje konkrétnější informa: One action provides more concrete information than a general statement. At the same time, it remains just a single sample from which you can learn and adjust it next time.

Jedno selhání nevyvrací hodnotu a jeden: One failure does not negate value, and one successful act does not definitively confirm it. Direction is shown in the ability to return to it repeatedly.

Při vyjasňování hodnot pomáhá porovnávat: When clarifying values, it helps to compare not only what a person identifies as important, but also the consequences of different options and the price they are willing to accept. Právě věta o návratu odlišuje živý kompa: It is precisely the sentence about returning that distinguishes a living compass from a rigid rule. After a mistake, you do not need to prove faultlessness. You need to recognize the next available step.

Obraz sebe se skládá z více rolí, vztahů: The image of oneself is made up of multiple roles, relationships, and experiences.
Člověk o sobě nenosí jedinou neměnnou in: A person does not carry a single unchanging piece of information about themselves. In different situations, different parts of self-concept come to the forefront: work roles, relationships, abilities, values, and personal experiences.
Když jedna role zabere téměř celý prosto: When one role occupies almost the entire space, its loss or weakening can affect the overall sense of one's own stability. Expanding the map does not mean devaluing the role, but stopping expecting it to explain the whole person.
Pokud člověk získává pocit vlastní hodno: If a person derives a sense of self-worth mainly from results, usefulness, or recognition, success brings relief only until the next evaluation. Periods without performance can then feel empty or threatening.
Silná pracovní nebo rodinná role sama o: A strong work or family role in itself is not a problem. What is important is its significance, the degree of choice, and whether there is still room for other parts of life alongside it.
Když se vlastní hodnota opírá hlavně o v: When one's self-worth relies mainly on performance, calmness is usually uncertain.
The goal is not to stop wanting good results. It is useful to expand the resources on which your self-image relies: your relationships with others, the way you treat yourself, courage, reliability, and the ability to learn from mistakes.
Radost z úspěchu ani silná pracovní moti: Joy in success or strong work motivation does not prove that your self-worth depends on performance. What matters is the recurring meaning you give to the results.
Příběh o sobě vybírá některé události a: A story about oneself selects certain events and leaves others out of focus.
V narativním pohledu člověk propojuje zk: From a narrative perspective, a person connects experiences into a story that gives their life continuity. A dominant sentence like 'I mess everything up' then easily attracts memories that confirm it, and overlooks exceptions.
Rozšíření příběhu neznamená přepsat bole: Expanding the story does not mean rewriting a painful experience as positive. It means adding events in which you behaved differently, learned something, or had more influence than the original sentence allows.
Jedna nalezená výjimka neruší dlouhodobo: One found exception does not invalidate long-term experience nor automatically change self-perception. It only opens up a more accurate and less closed description.
Nálepka zjednoduší orientaci, ale může z: A label simplifies orientation, but it can start to dictate before experience.
Označení jako „introvert“, „chaotik“ neb: Labels like 'introvert,' 'chaotic,' or 'the strong one' can quickly summarize part of an experience. However, when it turns into a fixed definition, a person stops considering the context and possibilities that do not fit into the label.
Důvěra ve vlastní schopnost roste z konk: Confidence in one's own ability grows from specific situations that have been mastered.
Pocit „tohle dokážu“ nevzniká jen přesvě: The feeling of 'I can do this' does not arise just from convincing oneself. Strong information comes from real experiences in which a person acted despite uncertainty, completed something, or returned for another attempt after failure.
Proto má smysl hledat malé, přesné důkaz: Therefore, it makes sense to look for small, precise evidence of quality. Not 'I am brave,' but 'I spoke my mind even though I was afraid of the reaction.' Concreteness helps not to overlook the experience.
Jeden povedený čin nepotvrzuje schopnost: One successful act does not confirm ability in all conditions. It only shows that the particular action was possible in one specific context.
Malá změna chování proto nemusí být jen: A small change in behavior therefore does not have to be just the result of a new identity. It can become an experience from which a more accurate sentence arises: 'I can be reliable and at the same time not respond immediately.'
Chování není čistým otiskem identity. Ov: Behavior is not a pure imprint of identity. It is influenced by conditions, power, fatigue, safety, and available options.
Mapa identity odděluje fakta, naučené vě: The identity map separates facts, learned sentences, and chosen direction.
Koučovací mapa nepátrá po jedné správné: The coaching map does not search for one correct answer to the question 'Who am I?'. It places side by side current roles, repeated stories, verifiable qualities, and behaviors that a person actually lives.
Terapeutická práce často odděluje člověk: Therapeutic work often separates the person from the problem or a single characteristic. Instead of 'I am incompetent,' one can examine in which situations helplessness appears, when it is weaker, and what the person is already doing differently then.
Nálepky mohou být užitečné pro komunikac: Labels can be useful for communication and self-understanding. They become a risk when they preclude the possibility of further experience in advance.
Opakované chování zpětně ovlivňuje, za k: Repeated behavior retroactively affects who we consider ourselves to be.
Sebepojetí ovlivňuje naše volby, ale vzt: Self-concept affects our choices, but the relationship works the other way around as well. When a person repeatedly acts like someone who is always available, their behavior provides further evidence for the same self-image.
V přístupech zaměřených na psychologicko: In approaches focused on psychological flexibility, the goal is not to create a perfectly certain version of oneself. A person chooses a course of action and learns to return to it even with present uncertainty, fear, or doubt.
Rozdělení vrstev vytváří prostor pro vol: The division of layers creates space for choice. A role can remain important, an old sentence can be understandable, and yet it does not have to determine every next step.
Výsledná mapa není diagnóza ani definiti: The resulting map is not a diagnosis or a definitive portrait. It is a working capture of the current state, which can change with further experience.
Změna nemusí čekat na pocit, že už jsi j: Change does not have to wait for the feeling that you are already a different person.
Směr „mluvit pravdivěji“ je použitelnějš: The direction 'to speak more truthfully' is more applicable than the requirement 'to become confident.' It does not require a complete transformation and allows searching for another feasible action.
Ochota jednat s nepříjemným pocitem nezn: Willingness to act with an unpleasant feeling does not mean ignoring safety, capacity, or real risk. The context remains part of the choice.
Stejný cíl lze naplňovat z různých důvod: The same goal can be pursued for different reasons and in different ways.
Cíl může být poháněný zájmem a osobním v: A goal can be driven by interest and personal significance, but also by pressure, shame, or the need for recognition. The result may look the same, while the experience and long-term sustainability differ.
A close relationship does not arise from the absence of conflict. What is important is the ability to stay in touch with your own experience, to perceive the other person, and to restore a safe conversation after being hurt.
Oprava může být malá: přiznat dopad svýc: A repair can be small: admitting the impact of your words, asking how the other person experienced the situation, or returning to the topic without further punishing with silence. It is precisely such steps that give relational identity a concrete form.
Oprava není povinnost zůstávat v nebezpe: A repair is not an obligation to stay in a dangerous or violent relationship. In some situations, the priority is distance, protection, and professional support.
Vedle otázky „Čeho chci dosáhnout?“ prot: Alongside the question 'What do I want to achieve?', it also helps to track the quality of the journey. How do you want to treat yourself, others, and your own limits while striving for the goal?
Vnější odměna automaticky nečiní cíl ciz: External reward does not automatically make a goal foreign or unhealthy. People commonly act for multiple reasons at the same time.
Kvalita vztahu se ukazuje také ve způsob: The quality of a relationship is also shown in the way it is repaired after a disagreement.

Když práce poskytuje význam, uznání, str: When work provides meaning, recognition, structure, and the main social role, a mistake does not only affect the evaluation of a task. It can shake the entire self-image.

Když je odpočinek podmíněný dokončením p: When rest is conditional on finishing work that, in fact, has no end, recovery is constantly postponed. A person then reacts only to exhaustion instead of to earlier signals of capacity.
Rozlišení člověka od výsledku neznamená: Distinguishing a person from the result does not mean giving up responsibility. It allows for a more accurate evaluation of performance: what was successful, what needs to be corrected, and what a single situation does not indicate at all.
Silná identifikace s prací není automati: Strong identification with work is not automatically harmful. The risk increases if other sources of meaning and stability almost disappear.

Při představování osobní budoucnosti se: When imagining personal future, brain networks are engaged that are also involved in recalling autobiographical memories. The mind recombines familiar people, places, and events into a possible future scene.
Psychologie popisuje možné podoby sebe j: Psychology describes possible versions of the self as images of who a person can become, who they would like to become, or what they fear. These images can guide attention and decision-making.
Užitečný obraz budoucího já není bezchyb: A useful image of the future self is not a flawless figure. It contains a recognizable quality and several ways to begin living it in the environment that a person actually has.

Konkrétní budoucí situaci skládáme z prv: We compose a specific future situation from elements of our own experience.
Proto bývá obyčejné úterý užitečnější ne: Therefore, an ordinary Tuesday is often more useful than an abstract image of a 'better life.' A specific morning, conversation, or work block provides more details for planning and for assessing whether such a life is truly desirable.
Živá představa není předpověď a nezaruču: A vivid imagination is not a prediction and does not guarantee realization. The future situation will be influenced by circumstances that you do not know today and cannot control.
Taková vize nesnižuje význam vzájemnosti: Such a vision does not diminish the importance of reciprocity. On the contrary, it helps to distinguish what you can bring into the relationship and what needs to arise together.
Vlastní změna nezaručuje změnu druhého a: Personal change does not guarantee change in the other person or a healthy relationship. Repeated disrespect of boundaries or violence requires protection, not better communication.
Smysluplná práce není jen povolání. Je t: Meaningful work is not just a profession. It is a relationship between activity, conditions, and personal significance.
